title: SmokedDuck Demonstration: SQLStepper
authors: Haneen Mohammed, Charlie Summers, Sughosh Kaushik, Eugene Wu
note: SQLStepper lets a reader step through a DuckDB query plan and see which input rows contributed to a result.

title: Lineage Resource Manager
note: This student research abstract examines how a database can manage the memory used to track lineage as queries run.

title: Lineage Querying at Interactive Speeds Using DuckDB
venue: ACM SIGMOD Student Research Competition · Philadelphia
note: I presented how DuckDB can trace an output row through indexed lineage data. The poster compares two join strategies on TPC-H queries. The project placed third in the graduate competition.

title: SQL Execution of Smoked Duck
venue: Columbia University · Advised by Eugene Wu
note: I implemented a physical scan operator and integrated lineage indexes into DuckDB so SQL could trace a query result back to its source rows.

title: Automated Test Script Generation from Natural Language Query
authors: Deepamala N., Tushar Kanakagiri, Shreyas Raghunath, Sughosh Kaushik, Shobha G., Ankit Singh, Deepak Jha
venue: International Journal of Innovative Technology and Exploring Engineering (IJITEE), 8(7), pp. 12–16
note: We explored two ways to turn a natural-language request into an executable test script by finding and reusing existing test procedures.
